name: CoVoST 2: Massively Multilingual Speech-to-Text Translation Benchmark
description: CoVoST 2 is a massively multilingual speech-to-text translation corpus spanning 2,880 hours of speech across 22 source languages. Created by Meta AI and published at Interspeech 2020, it covers 43 translation directions from non-English languages into English and from English into 15 target languages, built on Common Voice recordings.
